components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. Accepts spaces, dashes and
            brackets and an optional leading '+' with country code; stored and
            returned in E.164 form (a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits). When no
            country code is given, '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is
            dropped from the national digits.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^\+?[0-9 ()\-]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered. Defaults to the server's current date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Acknowledgement that this owner deliberately shares a household with an
            existing owner. When true, the create request is allowed even though
            another owner has the same last name and address; otherwise such a
            request is rejected as a conflict. Not persisted.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The pet owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of the first and last name, dot-separated with a trailing dot.

              readOnly: true
            customerCode:

## Change: shared household identifier

When a create request (`POST /api/owners`) sets `sharesHousehold: true`, the new owner is allowed to join a household already occupied by a same-last-name, same-address owner, and all members of that household are stamped with the same stable `householdId`, which is now returned on the owner resource.

### What I changed

1. **`openapi.yml`** — added a read-only `householdId` string to the `Owner` schema. This regenerates `OwnerDto` with the field, and MapStruct maps it automatically by name.

2. **`Owner` entity** (`model/Owner.java`) — added a persisted `householdId` field (`@Column(name = "household_id")`) with getter/setter, alongside the existing `customerCode`.

3. **DB schemas** — added a `household_id` column to the `owners` table in all four dialect schemas (hsqldb — used by tests, plus h2, mysql, postgres), since `ddl-auto=none` under the test profile means the column must exist.

4. **`HouseholdNormalizer`** — added a stable `id(lastName, address)` helper that derives the shared id deterministically from the existing normalized household key (SHA-256 → `H-XXXXXXXXXXXX`). Because it's a pure function of the household key, late joiners recompute the same id rather than needing a lookup.

5. **`AssignHousehold`** (new pipeline function) — when `sharesHousehold` is true and the new owner joins an existing household, it stamps the built owner and back-fills any existing members lacking the id (re-saving them). A lone owner keeps a null id (the collision path never reaches here — `EnsureUniqueHousehold` already rejects a non-acknowledged duplicate).

6. **`owners.POST.yml`** — wired `assignHousehold` into the pipeline between `assignCustomerCode` and `save`, under `govern: [ transaction ]`.

I kept responsibilities separate: `EnsureUniqueHousehold` still owns the allow/reject decision, `AssignHousehold` owns id assignment, and the shared household-key logic stays in `HouseholdNormalizer`.

The `AcceptanceTest` (`coreJoinersShareHouseholdId`) and the full suite are green.
